I have been farming maize here in the North Central for over thirty years, and I know this Guinea Savanna soil needs fertilizer to produce well. I will buy two bags of NPK for my whole farm and put a good share on this main maize plot, along with improved seed from the agro-dealer, because maize is the crop that feeds my family. I do not have money to waste on pesticides or irrigation—there is no fadama here and the rains have always been enough if I plant at the right time. My children and I will do the clearing, planting, and weeding, but I will hire two young men for a couple of days to help with the planting.
